# Lastelle AI

> Lastelle AI Corporation builds agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware as proprietary products, from algorithmic anomaly detection in capital markets to resource prospecting across the solar system. It was founded by Damien Rosecraft.

Source: https://lastelle.ai/
Last updated: 2026-10-31

## Intelligence synthesized by humans

Lastelle AI builds agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware as proprietary products, from market intelligence on Earth to resource prospecting beyond it.

From anomaly detection in capital markets to resource prospecting across the solar system

## Products

Software and hardware in development under the Lastelle AI name

### BARDT

Institutional-grade market intelligence built on algorithmic anomaly detection across every public company in biotech, aerospace, robotics, defense, technology, and energy. Each signal carries full provenance to its source data, and clients classify and filter the market to the exact segment they hold a view on. BARDT earns on two fronts: licensed access for institutional clients through a dedicated API, and proprietary capital deployed on its own signals. It is currently completing its historical backfill ahead of launch.

### Probe

A resource prospecting program spanning the solar system. Agentic systems sift published survey and mission data to map and rank resource-bearing asteroids, building the target catalog that will direct Lastelle-designed probes on scouting missions of their own. Probe positions Lastelle in the emerging space resource economy from its earliest stage.

### Hardware

A series of in-house systems with AI embedded at the device level, each agentically interoperable with every other Lastelle system. Initial applications span energy and defense. Every Lastelle defense system is non-lethal by design, built to detect, intercept, and protect.

## Mission

Lastelle AI builds proprietary intelligence and the hardware to carry it beyond Earth

BARDT anchors the company's capital base, converting market anomalies into licensed signal and disciplined capital deployment.

Those returns finance the longer horizon: a fleet of interoperable AI-embedded hardware and a prospecting program that charts the resources of the solar system, first through published data and later through probes of Lastelle's own design.

## FAQ

### What does Lastelle AI build?

Agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware, developed and owned as Lastelle products.

### Does Lastelle AI take client work?

Lastelle builds its own products exclusively. Inquiries about data licensing, API access, and partnerships are welcome.

### What technology are the systems built on?

State-of-the-art solutions from the frontier.

### Where does BARDT get its data?

Verified market data only, with every signal traceable to its source.

### When will BARDT launch?

On completion of its historical backfill, once its signals meet Lastelle's validation standard.

### How quickly will I hear back?

Within two business days.
